ios.desc:
LEVL turns your goals into a game you actually want to play.

Most habit apps feel like a chore. LEVL feels like leveling up a character—except the character is you. Complete your daily tasks, earn XP, build unbroken streaks, and watch yourself rank up in real life.

Whether you're chasing fitness, financial growth, mental strength, or a deeper walk with Christ, LEVL builds a daily plan around YOUR goals and keeps you showing up.

— WHY LEVL —

• A DAILY PLAN, BUILT FOR YOU
Tell us your goals and lifestyle. LEVL generates daily tasks designed to move you forward—no blank-page overwhelm.

• EARN XP & RANK UP
Every task you complete earns experience points and pushes you toward the next rank. Real progress you can see and feel.

• BUILD STREAKS, NEVER BREAK THE CHAIN
Momentum is everything. Watch your streak climb day after day and feel the pull to keep it alive.

• ALL YOUR PROGRESS IN ONE PLACE
Habits, to-dos, and long-term goals—tracked together with activity rings that fill as you crush your day.

• AN AI COACH THAT KNOWS YOU
LEVL's coach adapts to your patterns over time, remembers what you're working on, and pushes you exactly when you need it.

• REAL-TIME INSIGHTS
See your daily growth, momentum, and consistency at a glance. Know exactly where you stand.

— WHO LEVL IS FOR —

People who are done with empty motivation and ready to build real discipline. If you've ever wanted to become the strongest, sharpest, most consistent version of yourself—this is for you.

— PRIVACY FIRST —

Your habits, tasks, goals, and progress are stored on YOUR device. No account required. We don't track you, sell your data, or run ads.

— PREMIUM —

LEVL Premium unlocks your full experience. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the renewal date. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store settings.

Stop waiting for motivation. Build the discipline. Level up your life.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://levl-tos.lovable.app

quotes.text:
I’m a 15 and I just launched LEVL, a habit tracking and self improvement app that is gamified. You gain XP, level up, and rank up by doing the things you said you would do. It also gives you daily tasks based off of your goals.

I built it because every habit app I tried felt like a chore list and I wanted it to feel like a game.

I’d really appreciate any feedback at all (even pricing or marketing). Please try it out and let me what you think. It got a 3 day free trial.

It’s live on the App Store now: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/levl-self-improvement/id6777136507
